title: Muxed-account and offer IDs outside their valid range are encoded instead of refused
severity_basis: Builder input only: an out-of-range ID is wrapped modulo 2^64 into a different value (muxed ID 2^64 as 0, offer ID 2^64 as 0, offer ID 2^64-1 as -1), and a negative offer ID is encoded as is (-1 as ffffffffffffffff), which stellar-core rejects as malformed. No reader impact.

entries.expected: refuse an ID outside the field's XDR range (MuxedAccount.med25519.id: unsigned 64-bit)
entries.observed: Executed on 17.0.0 and 17.0.1: MuxedAccount accepts the ID 2^64 and encodes muxed ID 0, a different sub-account of the same account.

entries.expected: refuse an ID outside the field's XDR range (ManageSellOfferOp.offerID: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 17.0.0 and 17.0.1: ManageSellOffer accepts the offer ID 2^64 and encodes offer ID 0, which creates a new offer.

entries.expected: refuse an ID outside the field's XDR range (ManageSellOfferOp.offerID: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 17.0.0 and 17.0.1: ManageSellOffer accepts the offer ID 2^64-1 and encodes offer ID -1.

entries.expected: refuse an ID outside the field's XDR range (ManageSellOfferOp.offerID: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 17.0.0 and 17.0.1: ManageSellOffer accepts the offer ID -1 and encodes it as ffffffffffffffff, which stellar-core rejects as malformed (MANAGE_SELL_OFFER_MALFORMED). The default branch refuses it with a ValueError (offer ID outside 0 to 2^63-1); no release carries that yet.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --columns 'python@*' --entries 'cap-0027/api-muxed-account-id-encoding.*,classic/api-offer-id-encoding.*'), L4, on python@17.0.0 and python@17.0.1.
evidence.expected_basis: MuxedAccount.med25519.id is uint64 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-xdr/blob/v30.0/Stellar-transaction.x#L28) and ManageSellOfferOp.offerID is int64 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-xdr/blob/v30.0/Stellar-transaction.x#L164); a value outside those ranges has no encoding and should be refused, not wrapped.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone: the listed report rows failed again as recorded, offline. Failed again in the offline conformance runs of 2026-11-14.

evidence_added.reason: Filed upstream by a third party on 2026-11-13 with its own reproduction and a fix pull request (#1253); no new evidence added.

history.note: Created by xcc findings new from the known divergences that reference https://github.com/StellarCN/py-stellar-base/issues/1251 and their failure rows.
The upstream issue already records this defect (filed by a third party on 2026-11-13; fix pull request #1253 open).
Upstream state refreshed: the issue was closed on 2026-11-14 by the merged fix pull request #1253; no py-stellar-base release after 17.0.1 includes it yet.

Widened to the negative offer ID (classic/api-offer-id-encoding.id-negative), the same range check: 17.0.0 and 17.0.1 encode -1 as ffffffffffffffff (re-run on 17.0.1, the latest release, on 2026-11-19); the default branch at 8907e9c3 refuses it in raise_if_not_valid_offer_id, which no release carries yet.
